name: relay-proof
description: Record, run, and review app tests through an existing local Relay service.

interface.longDescription: Connect to an existing Relay service, observe your app, record a reusable Test, run it again, and inspect retained evidence. Change Proof remains an explicit specialist workflow.
defaultPrompt: Record a reusable test for this app.
Run my saved test and explain the result.
Prove the current change before merge.
